title: AE2 easy uncraft 64k for Growable cells 2 mod
description: Datapack recipe for easy and automated uncraft 64k items intended to use with mod Growable cells 2
body:
Want to automate easy 64k cell to is component? you come to right place. with this datapck you can do that! , this datapack is intended to use with Growable cells 2 mod, but can work without it if you want to use it!


Add recipe for uncraft fluid,item and portable version  64k to 64k ME Storage Component with loss of item cell housing. as you can see in photo.
